THE ANATOMY OF AGRARIAN DEBT
1. The Trigger
Crop failure, drought, or military draft prevents the cultivator from paying the baseline agricultural tax.
2. Pledging Family
The debtor pledges a daughter, wife, or son as an "antichretic" debt-servant to work off the interest.
3. Pledging Land
The debtor mortgages their ancestral subsistence land to the creditor.
4. Foreclosure
The creditor forecloses, reducing the citizen to a sharecropper on their own land
5. Flight
The disenfranchised citizen flees the land to join nomadic raider bands (Hapiru).
